text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ardan, Ardan... Are you sure aboutchoosing that for your birthdaypresent?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Quite. The mega birthday parfait can<n>only be
ordered on an Umamusume's<n>birthday... Which is to
say, we can<n>only experience it today. ♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Mgh... I don't know if the two of us<n>can finish such
a ginormous parfait,<n>but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Those who fear the starting gate will<n>never reach
the goal!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It means everything's worth<n>attempting once! Even
if we fail,<n>we're bound to have a good time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I understand now... Those are words<n>of wisdom,
indeed. Rather than<n>reflecting on the past or
lamenting<n>over the future, we should live in the<n>here
and now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Haha, it's really nothing that serious.But I'm happy you liked it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, why don't we go eat?<n>Mega birthday
parfait, here we come!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, let us go. As they say, "Those<n>who fear the
starting gate will never<n>reach the goal." ♪
